steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: select-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const w=s.floorPlan.walls[0]; window.__wid=w.id; s.setPlanSelection({ type:'wall', id:w.id }); })()

steps.name: shorten-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const w=s.floorPlan.walls.find(x=>x.id===window.__wid); const L=Math.hypot(w.end[0]-w.start[0], w.end[1]-w.start[1])||1; const ux=(w.end[0]-w.start[0])/L, uz=(w.end[1]-w.start[1])/L; const nl=2.0; s.updateWall(w.id, { end:[w.start[0]+ux*nl, w.start[1]+uz*nl] }); })()
